data.one_liner: Core package for Fluttium user flow testing framework.
data.what_it_does: Provides the core API for defining and executing user‑flow tests in Flutter. Includes actions such as tap, scroll, write text, long‑press and custom actions across all platforms.
use_when: you need end‑to‑end UI flow tests for a Flutter app
you want a declarative way to script user interactions across mobile, web and desktop
avoid_when: you only need unit or widget tests
you require a mature, feature‑complete testing suite with extensive reporting
strengths: rich set of built‑in actions (tap, scroll, swipe, write text, etc.)
weaknesses: minimal reporting and CI integration out of the box
data.setup_notes: Add fluttium as a dependency, ensure Flutter SDK >=3.10. No additional native setup or build_runner required.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: standard Dart/Flutter testing package for unit and widget tests without the need for a separate flow‑testing framework
